40009598.author: पदार्थः
40009598.content: ततः then, रणकर्कशः  tyrant in war, वाली Vali, रामेण by Rama, शरेण by an arrow, अभिहतः struck, निकृत्तः  felled, पादप: the tree, इव like, सहसा instantaneously, पपात fell down

40009598.author: Translation
40009598.content: A tyrant in war, Vali struck by4.54.24 Rama's arrow, collapsed instantaneously like a tree felled down.

40009599.author: पदार्थः
40009599.content: तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणः adorned with shining gold ornaments, सः he, मुक्तरश्मिः with the loosening of ropes, देवराजस्य Indra's, ध्वजः इव like the post, भूमौ on the ground, न्यस्तसर्वाङ्गः all limbs of body touching the ground, पपात fell down

40009599.author: Translation
40009599.content: Adorned with shining gold ornaments,Vali fell down with all his limbs touching the ground like Indra's flag when its ropes are loosened.

40009600.author: पदार्थः
40009600.content: वानराणाम् of the monkeys, गणेश्वरे lord of the troops, तस्मिन् him, भूमौ निपतिते when (he) fell on the ground, भूतलम् the earth, नष्टचन्द्रमिव like sky devoid of the Moon, व्योम sky, न व्यराजत not shine

40009600.author: Translation
40009600.content: When the lord of the monkey troops fell down, it was as though the earth lost its brightness like the sky loses its brightness devoid of the Moon.

40009601.author: पदार्थः
40009601.content: भूमौ on the ground, निपतितस्यापि even though fell down, महात्मनः  highsouled, तस्य it, देहम् body, श्रीः splendour, न जहाति not left, प्राणाः life, न not, तेजः glow, न not, पराक्रमः valour

40009601.author: Translation
40009601.content: Even though the highsouled Vali's body had fallen on the ground, its  splendour, glow, life and valour had not left it.

40009602.author: पदार्थः
40009602.content: शक्रदत्ता given by Indra, काञ्चनी golden, वज्रभूषिता decorated with diamonds, वरा most beautiful, माला necklace, हरिमुख्यस्य lord of the monkeys, प्राणान् life, तेज brightness, श्रियं च and splendour, दधार remained

40009602.author: Translation
40009602.content: As the most beautiful golden necklace, studded with diamonds, given by Indra was there on him, the life, brightness and splendour of Vali's body remained.

40009603.author: पदार्थः
40009603.content: वीरः hero, सः हरियूथपः that chief of monkeys, हेमया with golden, तयामालया with that necklace, सन्ध्यानुगतपर्यन्तः hallowed by the glowing twilight, पयोधरः इव like the raincloud, अभवत् appeared

40009603.author: Translation
40009603.content: Vali, the chief hero of the monkeys, with his golden necklace appeared like the raincloud hallowed by the glowing twilight.

40009604.author: पदार्थः
40009604.content: पतितस्यापि even though he had fallen down, तस्य his, माला च necklace, देहः च body and,मर्मघाती  pierced into the vital parts, यः शरः that arrow, त्रिधा in three ways, रचिता the effect, लक्ष्मीः the effulgence, इव similar , शोभते shining

40009604.author: Translation
40009604.content: Even though he had fallen down, the effulgence of his necklace on his body, and the arrow pierced into his vital parts remained.

40009605.author: पदार्थः
40009605.content: स्वर्गमार्गप्रभावनम् that which paves the way to heaven (for the dead), रामबाणा Rama's arrow, सनक्षिप्तम् released, तत् that, अस्त्रम् weapon, तस्य वीरस्य that hero's, परमां गतिम् supreme destination, आवहत् created

40009605.author: Translation
40009605.content: Rama's arrow released paved the way to heaven which was that hero's supreme destination.

40009606.author: पदार्थः
40009606.content: सङ्ख्ये in the battle , तदा then, पतितम् fallen, भुवि on the ground, आदित्यमिव like the Sun,  गतार्चिषम् fire without flame, अनलम् इव fire like, पुण्यान्ते after exhaustion of the merits, कालेन by the time, देवलोकात् the abode of gods, इह here, च्युतम् descended down, युगान्ते at the end of aeon (at the end of the world), ययातिमिव like Yayati, महेन्द्रमिव like Indra, दुर्धर्षम् unassailable, उपेन्द्रमिव like Upendra, दुःसहम् intolerable,महेन्द्रपुत्रम् son of Indra, हेममालिनम् adorned with golden necklace, सिंहोरस्कम् lionchested, महाबाहुम् of mighty arms, दीप्तास्यम् with a bright face, हरिलोचनम् tawnyeyed, तं वालिनम् that Vali, लक्ष्मणानुगतो followed by Lakshmna, रामः Rama, पतितम् fallen, ददर्श saw, उपससर्प च approached, शनैरिव slowly, वीक्षमाणम् observing, तं वीरम् that hero, बहुमान्य  admiringly.

40009606.author: Translation
40009606.content: Rama followed by Lakshmana slowly approached the longarmed, lionchested, brightfaced, tawnyeyed Vali, and admiringly observed this unchallengeable son of Indra, unassailable like Indra himself. Adorned with a golden necklace, he had fallen on the ground like fire without flame, like king Yayati descended on the earth from the celestial realm on the exhaustion of his merits, or like the Sun cast down on the earth at the end of the aeon.

40009607.content: सङ्ख्ये in the battle , तदा then, पतितम् fallen, भुवि on the ground, आदित्यमिव like the Sun,  गतार्चिषम् fire without flame, अनलम् इव fire like, पुण्यान्ते after exhaustion of the merits, कालेन by the time, देवलोकात् the abode of gods, इह here, च्युतम् descended down, युगान्ते at the end of aeon (at the end of the world), ययातिमिव like Yayati, महेन्द्रमिव like Indra, दुर्धर्षम् unassailable, उपेन्द्रमिव like Upendra, दुःसहम् intolerable,महेन्द्रपुत्रम् son of Indra, हेममालिनम् adorned with golden necklace, सिंहोरस्कम् lionchested, महाबाहुम् of mighty arms, दीप्तास्यम् with a bright face, हरिलोचनम् tawnyeyed, तं वालिनम् that Vali, लक्ष्मणानुगतो followed by Lakshmna, रामः Rama, पतितम् fallen, ददर्श saw, उपससर्प च approached, शनैरिव slowly, वीक्षमाणम् observing, तं वीरम् that hero, बहुमान्य  admiringly.

40009610.author: पदार्थः
40009610.content: तं राघवम् to, Rama, महाबलम् powerful, लक्ष्मणं च and to Lakshmana, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, वाचा by word, परुषम् pride, धर्मसंहितम् righteous, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् said, त्वं नराधिपतेः पुत्रैः you are a prince, प्रथितः famous, प्रियदर्शनः handsome, कुलीनस्सत्त्वसम्पन्नः born in  a noble family, तेजस्वी  brilliant, चरितव्रतः follower of good practices, युद्धसंरब्धः while waging war, अहम् I, यत् ताडित गतः hit, पराङ्मुखवधम् killing one who was engaged otherwise ,कृत्वा having done that, अत्र there, कः what, गुणः merit, त्वया by you, प्राप्तः gained

40009610.author: Translation
40009610.content: On seeing powerful Rama and Lakshmana approaching,Vali spoke with pride and rigteousness to Rama, 'You are a prince, born of a noble family, son of a renowned king. You are famous, brilliant, handsome and follower of good practices.Having hit me when I was engaged otherwise in an encounter what merit have you gained?'

40009611.author: पदार्थः
40009611.content: तं राघवम् to, Rama, महाबलम् powerful, लक्ष्मणं च and to Lakshmana, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, वाचा by word, परुषम् pride, धर्मसंहितम् righteous, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् said, त्वं नराधिपतेः पुत्रैः you are a prince, प्रथितः famous, प्रियदर्शनः handsome, कुलीनस्सत्त्वसम्पन्नः born in  a noble family, तेजस्वी  brilliant, चरितव्रतः follower of good practices, युद्धसंरब्धः while waging war, अहम् I, यत् ताडित गतः hit, पराङ्मुखवधम् killing one who was engaged otherwise ,कृत्वा having done that, अत्र there, कः what, गुणः merit, त्वया by you, प्राप्तः gained

You are famous, brilliant, handsome and follower of good practices.Having hit me when I was engaged otherwise in an encounter what merit have you gained?'

You are famous, brilliant, handsome and follower of good practices.Having hit me when I was engaged otherwise in an encounter what merit have you gained?'

40009613.author: पदार्थः
40009613.content: रामः Rama, करुणवेदी च a kind soul, प्रजानाम् of people,हिते in the wellbeing, रतः engaged,  सानुक्रोशः compassionate, जितोत्साहः enthusiastic, समयज्ञः one who has a sense of time, दृढव्रतः steadfast in vows, इति in this way, ते your, यशः fame, सर्वभूतानि all beings, भुवि the world, कथयन्ति praise you

40009613.author: Translation
40009613.content: All beings proclaim your fame throughout the world, saying: Rama is compassionate, devoted to his people's welfare, kindly, enthusiastic, mindful of the right occasion, and steadfast in his vows.

40009614.author: पदार्थः
40009614.content: रामः Rama, करुणवेदी च a kind soul, प्रजानाम् of people,हिते in the wellbeing, रतः engaged,  सानुक्रोशः compassionate, जितोत्साहः enthusiastic, समयज्ञः one who has a sense of time, दृढव्रतः steadfast in vows, इति in this way, ते your, यशः fame, सर्वभूतानि all beings, भुवि the world, कथयन्ति praise you

40009614.author: Translation
40009614.content: All beings proclaim your fame throughout the world, saying: Rama is compassionate, devoted to his people's welfare, kindly, enthusiastic, mindful of the right occasion, and steadfast in his vows.

40009615.author: पदार्थः
40009615.content: राजन् O king, दमः selfcontrol, शमः control of mind, intellect, memory and ego क्षमा tolerance, धर्मः righteousness, धृतिः forbearance, सत्यम् truthfulness, पराक्रमः valour, अपराधिषु towards the offenders, दण्डश्च punishment, पार्थिवानाम् for king's, गुणाः virtues

40009615.author: Translation
40009615.content: 'O king selfcontrol (of organs of action and sense organs), righteousness, steadfastness, truthfulness, valiance and capacity to punish the offenders are virtues  of a king.

40009616.author: पदार्थः
40009616.content: अहम् I am, तान् them, गुणान् virtues, तव your, अग्र्यम् foremost, अभिजनम् noble, सम्प्रधार्य considered, तारया by Tara, प्रतिषिद्धः अपि even though forewarned, सुग्रीवेण with Sugriva, समागतः came for a combat

40009616.author: Translation
40009616.content: 'Believing that you are a repository of all these virtues are in you, and respecting your noble lineage I engaged in a duel with Sugriva even though I was forewarned (by Tara).

40009617.author: पदार्थः
40009617.content: तव your, आदर्शने not seen, अन्येन with others, सम्रब्धम् engaged in combat, प्रमत्तम् engrossed, माम् me, योद्धुम् attacked, नार्हसि not proper on your part, इति thus, मे my, बुद्धि: mind, उत्पन्ना strike, बभूव become

40009617.author: Translation
40009617.content: The conviction arose in my mind that, being unseen by you, you would not strike me while I was off my guard and engaged in combat with another.

40009618.author: पदार्थः
40009618.content: त्वाम् to you, विनिहतात्मानम् who has killed his soul( one who acts against his conscience), धर्मध्वजम् functioning under the banner of (showing off) virtue, अधार्मिकम्  unrighteous, पापसमाचारम् sinful in conduct, तृणैः by grass, आवृतम् covered, कूपम् इव like a well, न जाने I did not know

40009618.author: Translation
40009618.content: 'I did not know that you have killed your soul (by acting against your conscience), that you are sinful in conduct and unrighteous under the show of virtues like a well, its mouth covered with grass.

40009619.author: पदार्थः
40009619.content: सताम् of piety, वेषधरम्  covered, पापम् a sinner, प्रच्छनम् a disguised person, पावकम् इव like fire, धर्मच्छद्माभिसंवृतम् with righteousness as a pretext, त्वाम् to you, अहम् I,  न अभिजानामि did not recognise

40009619.author: Translation
40009619.content: 'You are a sinful man covered with the mask of piety thus resembling a hidden fire. I failed to recognise that righteousness is a mere pretext for you.

40009620.author: पदार्थः
40009620.content: अहम् I am, यदा when, ते your, विषये वा or in your affairs, पुरे वा or in your city, पापम् sin, न करोमि I did not, त्वाम् to you, न च and not, अवजाने I did  not insult you, अकिल्बिषम् not done any harm to you, नित्यम् always, फलमूलाशनम् living on fruits and roots, वनगोचरम् roaming in the forest, वानरम् monkey, इह here, अप्रतियुध्यन्तम् not come to battle with you, अन्येन others, समागतम् come, माम् me, कस्मात् why, हंसि do you kill

40009620.author: Translation
40009620.content: 'I did no harm to your affairs or to your city. I did not insult you. Why did you choose to kill me, a monkey roaming in the forest and living on fruits and roots? I was not fighting you. Why did you come and strike a person like me?

40009621.author: पदार्थः
40009621.content: अहम् I am, यदा when, ते your, विषये वा or in your affairs, पुरे वा or in your city, पापम् sin, न करोमि I did not, त्वाम् to you, न च and not, अवजाने I did  not insult you, अकिल्बिषम् not done any harm to you, नित्यम् always, फलमूलाशनम् living on fruits and roots, वनगोचरम् roaming in the forest, वानरम् monkey, इह here, अप्रतियुध्यन्तम् not come to battle with you, अन्येन others, समागतम् come, माम् me, कस्मात् why, हंसि do you kill

40009621.author: Translation
40009621.content: 'I did no harm to your affairs or to your city. I did not insult you. Why did you choose to kill me, a monkey roaming in the forest and living on fruits and roots? I was not fighting you. Why did you come and strike a person like me?

40009622.author: पदार्थः
40009622.content: त्वम् you, प्रियदर्शनः pleasing in appearance, नराधिपतेः पुत्रः son of a king, प्रतीतः famous, राजन् O king, ते to you, धर्मसंहितम् righteous one, लिङ्गमपि  even signs, अस्ति are, दृश्यते found

40009622.author: Translation
40009622.content: 'O prince, you are son to a king, handsome and famous. Even signs of righteousness are discernible in you.

40009623.author: पदार्थः
40009623.content: क्षत्रियकुले in a kshatriya family, जातः born, श्रुतवान् one who has read the Vedas, नष्टसंशयः free from doubt, धर्मलिङ्गप्रतिच्छन्नः in the guise of a righteous person, कः who, क्रूरम् cruel, कर्म deed, समाचरेत् will do

40009623.author: Translation
40009623.content: 'Who, born in a kshatriya family, versed in the Vedas and free from doubt will commit such a cruel act under the guise of righteousness?

40009624.author: पदार्थः
40009624.content: राजकुले in royal family, जातः born, धर्मवानिति  proficient in dharma, विश्रुतः wellknown, राम Rama, अभव्यः unworthy, भव्यरूपेण attire, किमर्थम् for what reason, परिधावसे running

40009624.author: Translation
40009624.content: 'You are born in a royal family. You are wellknown. You are proficient in dharma. Yet you are unworthy  of your race and robe.

40009625.author: पदार्थः
40009625.content: राजन् O king, साम conciliation, दानम् generosity, क्षमा forbearance, धर्मः righteousness, सत्यम् truth, धृतिपराक्रमौ steadfast in valour, अपराधिषु at the offenders, दण्डः punishment, पार्थिवानाम् of the rulers, गुणाः hallmarks

40009625.author: Translation
40009625.content: 'Conciliation, generosity, forbearance, righteousness, truthfulness, steadfastness in valour and punishing offenders are the hallmarks of rulers.

40009626.author: पदार्थः
40009626.content: राम Rama, वयम् we, मूलफलाशना: live on roots and fruits, वनचराः wanderers in forest, मृगाः animals, एषा this, अस्माकम् our, प्रकृतिः nature, त्वम् you, नरेश्वरः lord of men, पुरुषः a man

40009626.author: Translation
40009626.content: 'O Rama we are mere animals wandering in the forest and living on roots and fruits. This is our nature. (But) you are a lord of men.

40009627.author: पदार्थः
40009627.content: विग्रहे in battle, भूमिः land, हिरण्यम् gold, रूप्यं च and silver, कारणानि reasons, तत्र there, ते to you, वने in the forest, मदीयेषु in my belongings, फलेषु in fruits वा or, लोभः greediness, कः what for?

40009627.author: Translation
40009627.content: 'We fight for land or gold or silver. What did you fight me for, for what I have or for the fruits of the forest?

40009628.author: पदार्थः
40009628.content: नयश्च  submissiveness, विनयश्च  modesty, निग्रहानुग्रहौ  restraint and favour, उभावपि both are, असङ्कीर्णा not to be mixed up, राजवृत्तिः king's functions, नृपाः kings, कामवृत्तयः impulsive, न not excercise

40009628.author: Translation
40009628.content: 'Submissiveness and modesty are the attributes of good rulers and should not be mixed up with benevolence and selfrestraint. Kings ought not to act (as they like) impulsively.

40009629.author: पदार्थः
40009629.content: त्वं तु you also, कामप्रधानश्च fulfilling your own desire is important, कोपनश्च wrathful, अनवस्थितः unstable, राजवृत्तेश्च royal course of conduct, सङ्कीर्णः intermingled, शरासनपरायणः you have  discharged arrows

40009629.author: Translation
40009629.content: 'Fulfilling your own desire is important for you. You are wrathful and unstable with royal course of conduct. Your business is with your bow and arrows.

40009630.author: पदार्थः
40009630.content: मनुजेश्वरः lord of men, ते to you, धर्मे in righteousness, उपचितिः not have faith, न not, बुद्धि: intellect, अर्थे material wealth, न अवस्थिता not steadfast, कामवृत्तः सन् overcome by delusion, इन्द्रियैः by the senses, कृष्यसे you are drawn

40009630.author: Translation
40009630.content: 'O lord of men you have no faith in righteousness, no steadfastness in the acquisition of wealth. You have no control over the senses. You are overcome by delusion.

40009631.author: पदार्थः
40009631.content: काकुत्स्थ O scion of the Kakutstha race, अनपराधिनम् one who has not done any harm, मा to me, इह here, बाणेन by arrow, हत्वा having killed, जुगुप्सितम् abominable, कर्म deed, कृत्वा after commiting, सताम् to the holy people, मध्ये midst, किम् what, वक्ष्यसि will you answer?

40009631.author: Translation
40009631.content: 'O scion of the Kakutsthas Having killed me here with your arrow even though I have done you no harm, you have perpetrated an abominable act. How will you defend yourself in the midst of holy men after commiting such a sinful act?

40009632.author: पदार्थः
40009632.content: राजहा killer of a king, ब्रह्महा  killer of brahmin, गोघ्नः  killer of cows, चोर: a thief, प्राणिवधेरत: killer of living beings,नास्तिकः atheist, परिवेत्ता च and one who marries before his elder sibling, सर्वे all, निरयगामिनः will go to hell

40009632.author: Translation
40009632.content: 'One who kills a king, a brahmin or a cow, a thief or one who delights in destruction of life an atheist or one who marries before his elder  they all go to hell.

40009633.author: पदार्थः
40009633.content: सूचकः च a talebearer, कदर्यः च and a mean fellow, मित्रघ्नः murderer of a friend, गुरुतल्पगः one who shares the bed of the Guru's wife, एते these people, पापात्मनाम् of sinners, लोकम् to the world, गच्छन्ते will go, अत्र there, संशयः doubt, न no

40009633.author: Translation
40009633.content: A tale-bearer, a miser, a betrayer of friends, and one who defiles his guru's bed—these surely go to the world of sinners, there is no doubt.

40009634.author: पदार्थः
40009634.content: मे mine, चर्म skin, अधार्यम् is not fit to be worn, रोमाणि hair, सदभी: by the virtuous, अस्थि च bone also, वर्जितम् is prohibited, त्वद्विधैः by men like you also, धर्मचारिभिः by righteous people, मांसानि flesh, अभक्ष्याणि च is not fit for eating

40009634.author: Translation
40009634.content: 'My skin is not fit to be worn by the virtuous, my hair and bones are also prohibited from any use. My flesh is also not at all fit to be eaten by righteous people like you

40009635.author: पदार्थः
40009635.content: राघव Rama, ब्रह्मक्षत्रेण by brahmin and kshatriya, शल्यकः porcupine, श्वाविधः the hedgehog, गोधा the alligator, शशः the rabbit, कूर्मश्च the turtle, पञ्चमः the five, पञ्चनखाः fivenailed creatures, भक्ष्याः are permitted to be eaten

40009635.author: Translation
40009635.content: 'O Rama brahmins and kshatriyas are permitted to eat only the five nailed animals the porcupine, the hedgehog, the alligator, the rabbit and the tortoise.

40009636.author: पदार्थः
40009636.content: राजन O king, मनीषिणः learned people, मे mine, चर्म च even skin, अस्थीनि bone, न स्पृशन्ति do not touch, मांसानि च and the flesh, अभक्ष्याणि should not be eaten, पञ्चमः five nailed animal, सः अहम् such me, हतः killed

40009636.author: Translation
40009636.content: 'O king the learned do not even touch my skin or bone. They do not eat my flesh. While it is so, you have unnecessarily killed me, a fivenailed animal.

40009637.author: पदार्थः
40009637.content: सर्वज्ञया by the omniscient, तारया by Tara, अहम् I, सत्यम् truth, हितम् wellbeing, वाक्यम् words, उक्तः warned, मोहेन out of ignorance or arrogance, तत् that, अतिक्रम्य overriding, कालस्य  of yama (the lord of death), वशम् fold, आगतः came under

40009637.author: Translation
40009637.content: 'Tara knew everything. Her words were correct. They were meant for my wellbeing. However, due to my ignorance (or arrogance), I did not heed her words and fell under the sway of the lord of death

40009638.author: पदार्थः
40009638.content: काकुत्स्थ Kakutstha, वसुन्धरा earth, नाथेन by lord, त्वया by you, शीलसम्पन्ना one endowed with good character, प्रमदा a lady, धूर्तेन by a wicked one, यथा similarly, पतिना by husband, सनाथा a protector, न no

40009638.author: Translation
40009638.content: 'O Kakutstha just as a wife endowed with good character cannot be protected by a wicked husband, you cannot be a protector of this earth.

40009639.author: पदार्थः
40009639.content: शठः treacherous, नैकृतिकः dishonest, क्षुद्रः mean, मिथ्याप्रश्रितमानसः guised with false humility, पापः sinner, त्वम् you, महात्मना highsouled, दशरथेन to Dasaratha, कथम् how, जातः were you born?

40009639.author: Translation
40009639.content: 'You are treacherous, dishonest, mean, guised with false humility and a sinner to the core. How were you born to that highsouled Dasaratha?

40009640.author: पदार्थः
40009640.content: छिन्नचारित्रकक्ष्येण breaking through the chains of good character, सताम् the sages, धर्मातिवर्तिना trespassing moral code of conduct, त्यक्तधर्माङ्कुशेन discharging sharp arrow of righteousness, रामहस्तिना the elephant called Rama, अहम् I, निहतः killed

40009640.author: Translation
40009640.content: 'Breaking through the chains of good character, trespassing the moral code of conduct of the sages, discharging the sharp arrow of righteousness, the elephantine (arrogant) Rama killed me.

40009641.author: पदार्थः
40009641.content: अशुभम् inauspicious, अयुक्तम् not fit, सताम् to the noble, विगर्हितम् despised, ईदृशम् such, कृत्वा after doing, सद्भिः सह by the noble, समागतः meet with, वक्ष्यसे you say.

40009641.author: Translation
40009641.content: 'You have committed an inauspicious, improper act, despised by the virtuous. What will you speak when you are questioned by noble men for committing such an act?

40009642.author: पदार्थः
40009642.content: राजन O king, उदासीनेषु to the indifferent people, अस्मासु towards us, यः such, अयम् this, विक्रमः power, प्रकाशितः shown, विक्रमम् such valour, अपकारिषु to the harmful, न पश्यामि do not see

40009642.author: Translation
40009642.content: 'O king you have exhibited your valour against one who has done you no harm. Why have you not shown such valour on those who have offended you?

40009643.author: पदार्थः
40009643.content: नृपात्मज O prince, यदि if, दृश्यमानः openly, मया by me, युद्ध्येथाः you had fought, मया by me, निहतः killed, अद्य  today, त्वम् you, वैवस्वतं देवम् Vaivasvata, the lord of death, पश्येः you would have seen.

40009643.author: Translation
40009643.content: 'O prince had  you fought me face to face you would have seen Vaivasvata, the lord of death today (you would have been killed by me).

40009644.author: पदार्थः
40009644.content: दुरासदः an unassailable warrior, अहम् I am, रणे in battle, अदृश्येन not seen, त्वया by you, पानवशं गतः in a drunken state, प्रसुप्तः  in deep sleep, नरः man, पन्नगेनेव like by the snake, निहतः killed

40009644.author: Translation
40009644.content: bitten to death by a snake while fast asleep.

40009645.author: पदार्थः
40009645.content: सुग्रीवप्रियकामेन to please Sugriva, त्वया by you, अहम् me, यत् since, निहतः killed, त्वम् you, एतदर्थम् on this account, पूर्वम् earlier, मामेव to me only, अचोदयः यदि if you had sought, रावणम् Ravana, रणे in battle, निहतम् killed, कण्ठे by the neck, बद्ध्वा tying, ते you, प्रदद्याम् I would have handed over

40009645.author: Translation
40009645.content: 'Had you sought my help earlier(before you met Sugriva), I would have restored Sita to you within a single day. I have been killed by you to oblige Sugriva. I would have handed over Ravana by the neck after killing him in the battle.

40009646.author: पदार्थः
40009646.content: सुग्रीवप्रियकामेन to please Sugriva, त्वया by you, अहम् me, यत् since, निहतः killed, त्वम् you, एतदर्थम् on this account, पूर्वम् earlier, मामेव to me only, अचोदयः यदि if you had sought, रावणम् Ravana, रणे in battle, निहतम् killed, कण्ठे by the neck, बद्ध्वा tying, ते you, प्रदद्याम् I would have handed over

40009646.author: Translation
40009646.content: 'Had you sought my help earlier(before you met Sugriva), I would have restored Sita to you within a single day. I have been killed by you to oblige Sugriva. I would have handed over Ravana by the neck after killing him in the battle.

40009647.author: पदार्थः
40009647.content: सागरतोये वा even from the water of the ocean, पातालेऽपि वा or even in the underworld, न्यस्ताम् hidden, मैथिलीम् Sita, तव your, आदेशात् by your order, श्वेताम्  like Sweta, अश्वतरीमिव like Aswatari, अनये यम् I could have brought

40009647.author: Translation
40009647.content: 'Even if she were hidden in the waters of the ocean or in the underworld, I would have brought her by your order like Sweta to Aswatari or Hayagriva. (Hayagriva, an incarnation of Visnu brought Vedas stolen by demons, Madhu and Kaitabha from Patala or the netherworld)

40009648.author: पदार्थः
40009648.content: मयि in me, स्वर्गते on going to heaven, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, राज्यम् kingdom, प्राप्नुयात् इति getting as such, युक्तम् is right, अहम् I, रणे in war, त्वया by your, अधर्मेण by unjustifiable means, निहतः इति यत् this way been killed, अयुक्तम् not proper

40009648.author: Translation
40009648.content: 'Sugriva inheriting the kingdom after my departure to heaven is proper. But your killing me this way in the combat by unjustifiable means is not.

40009649.author: पदार्थः
40009649.content: लोकः the world, एवं विधः in this way, कामं indeed, कालेन  when time of death comes, विनियुज्यते hiding, क्षमं चेत् is it right, भवता for you, प्राप्तम् achieved, उत्तरम् reply, साधु properly, चिन्त्यताम् think over

40009649.author: Translation
40009649.content: 'Indeed, in the world people meet with death when the time comes. Hiding yourself (from me) you have achieved it. Is it proper for you? You may think over and give your reply.'
